scientific_integrity: Fully stated analytical proof and independent exact-rational finite checks. No claim of external certification or of a full joint degree-distribution formula.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted Cartesian products of two complete graphs, each factor of size at least two; only ambient-adjacent vertex degrees. General determinant and degree-correlation formalisms are prior art. The exact triangular-number sign threshold is the assessed specialization; historical priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp aspect-ratio threshold for neighboring degrees in uniform rook-graph spanning trees
